paragraph: The tax authority AGT has built its own machine-learning tools, [tested from 2024](<https://correiokianda.info/inteligencia-artificial-coloca-incumpridores-sob-analise-reforcada-da-agt/>). [In July 2026 its chair said they cross-checked 2025 corporate income tax filings and flagged irregular filers](<https://expansao.co.ao/empresas/detalhe/inteligencia-artificial-da-agt-apanha-15-mil-empresas-suspeitas-de-fuga-ao-fisco-73137.html>). In the last twelve months, [AGT launched its ASY5 customs system at Luanda port in June 2026, with AI risk management](<https://angop.ao/noticias/economia/agt-expande-sistema-automatizado-ao-porto-de-luanda/>). [On 30 April 2026 the telecoms ministry said the space programme office runs AI platforms for mining, offshore oil and agriculture](<https://minttics.gov.ao/ao/noticias/minttics-destaca-potencial-do-data-center-e-cloud-nacional-para-reforcar-a-adopcao-da-ia-no-pais/>). In February 2026 [an AI pilot in primary schools](<https://www.verangola.net/va/pt/022026/Educacao/47639/Escolas-prim%C3%A1rias-v%C3%A3o-passar-a-contar-com-Intelig%C3%AAncia-Artificial.htm>) was only being installed. No measured results of the space programme office's platforms have been found.

The national malaria programme [trained health workers in Cibitoke and Kirundo on 16 July 2025 on an AI app that reads rapid malaria tests](<https://open.enabel.be/en/BDI/2671/3216/u/l-intelligence-artificielle-au-service-du-diagnostic-du-paludisme-au-burundi.html>). Enabel calls it a pilot. A team is [piloting an AI-powered mpox early-warning dashboard in three health districts of Bujumbura](<https://www.ai4d.ai/fr/innovations/ai-powered-surveillance-and-response-network>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says an AI tool is in service in a public sector's system, and neither pilot is reported at work across the health system. Establishing would need an AI tool in service in a public sector's system and producing outputs, such as diagnoses, risk scores, forecasts or notices.

Webb Fontaine, the vendor, said in February 2025 that Benin's customs system was [in use at 44 of the 49 customs offices](<https://webbfontaine.com/news/benin-customs-management-milestones>). It says the system [now bases risk management on AI profiling of importers and goods and detects fraud patterns automatically](<https://webbfontaine.com/news/webb-customs-the-new-digital-weapon-against-customs-fraud-in-benin>). In 2026, within the last twelve months, the health ministry [awarded a contract for 20 AI-assisted malaria diagnostic devices for referral hospitals](<https://www.wearetech.africa/fr/fils/actualites/tech/paludisme-le-benin-integre-l-ia-dans-son-dispositif-national-de-diagnostic>), which are still being procured. No source found reports AI in service in a second sector. Operating would need AI tools in service in the public systems of two or more sectors.

The national TB programme's coordinator said the AI tool CAD4TB was [introduced in 2024 to read images from the programme's mobile digital X-ray units](<https://delftimaging.com/resources/webinars/advancing-tb-screening-in-burkina-faso-with-portable-x-ray-and-cad4tb/>). It is used in field screening campaigns. The coordinator reported that [from September 2024 to April 2025 the campaigns screened 1,730 people and found 61 TB cases](<https://delftimaging.com/resources/webinars/advancing-tb-screening-in-burkina-faso-with-portable-x-ray-and-cad4tb/>). In May 2026, within the last twelve months, the KIX-SEEDS project said [a machine-learning module predicting school dropout is among the tools of its pilot in the communes of Manga and Bingo](<https://seeds.bf/post_detail/4d824034-e6d1-4182-acf5-b8088d4a5a42>). That is a pilot. No source found says AI is in service in a second sector. Operating would need AI tools in service in the public systems of two or more sectors.

A vendor partner says the national TB programme [deployed AI chest X-ray reading in April 2025](<https://vertice.co.za/advancing-tb-screening-in-botswana-with-quire-ai-technology/>). [The U.S. Embassy says PEPFAR donated AI software for TB detection to the Ministry of Health](<https://bw.usembassy.gov/usg-donates-tb-ai-software-to-moh/>) in 2025. In the last twelve months, [on 25 November 2026 the firm Amini said it is working with the Ministry of Minerals and Energy to digitise geological records](<https://techcabal.com/2026/11/25/amini-africa-paper-archives-data-ai/>). No tax, customs, education or agriculture system with AI has been found. No measured results of a sectoral AI system have been found. Operating would need AI tools in service in the public systems of two or more sectors.

MSF reports that, with the health authorities, it [equipped Batangafo district hospital in 2024 with an AI tool that scores chest X-rays](<https://www.msf.ch/nos-actualites/articles/republique-centrafricaine-lia-au-service-du-depistage-tuberculose>). MSF reports that the tool [helped detect 90 of the 203 TB cases screened in the Batangafo area](<https://www.msf.ch/nos-actualites/articles/republique-centrafricaine-lia-au-service-du-depistage-tuberculose>) in 2025. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Every AI tool held is in health, and no single source found says AI is in service in the public systems of two or more sectors. Operating would need AI tools in service in the public systems of two or more sectors.

In May 2025 the finance minister said the tax administration [uses AI to segment taxpayers by category](<https://finances.gouv.ci/actualites/65-contenu-dynamique/actualite/1126-lancement-du-rapport-sur-le-developpement-humain-rdh-2025-panel-ministeriel-de-haut-niveau-le-ministre-adama-coulibaly-releve-l-importance-de-l-intelligence-artificielle-pour-le-budget-national>). In March 2024 the state bureau BNETD [presented a land-cover map with AI recognition of forests on satellite imagery](<https://news.abidjan.net/articles/729948/cote-divoire-le-bnetd-presente-la-carte-doccupation-des-sols-2020-avec-lappui-du-programme-cacao-durable-de-lunion-europeenne>). Since 5 October 2026, within the last twelve months, health workers in Gontougo have [used a platform whose AI gives treatment advice and flags inconsistent data](<https://www.mhealth-africa.org/en/actualites/la-cote-divoire-deploie-mhealth-one-la-version-de-mhealth-integrant-lintelligence-artificielle/>). No earlier position for health has been found. No single source found says AI is in service in several sectors, and no measured results have been found. Operating would need AI tools in service in the public systems of two or more sectors.

In February 2026 the director general of the social insurance fund CNPS said the fund [runs a symbolic-AI system for automatic processing of old-age pension files](<https://www.digitalbusiness.africa/cameroun-avancees-piliers-et-dangers-de-l-ia-presentes-a-un-atelier-du-minpostel-dedie-aux-administrations-publics/>). The director general also said its [AI tools detect fraud by finding inconsistencies in declarations and contributions](<https://theguardianpostcameroon.com/post/6734/en/homeat-govt-artificial-intelligence-workshop-cnps-director-general-showcases-ai-use-in-social-security-services>). In the last twelve months, on 17 August 2026, the secondary-education ministry [presented the official integration of AI-generated simulations in secondary schools](<https://www.digitalbusiness.africa/e-education-cameroun-le-minesec-valide-la-simulation-ia-avantages-et-limites/>). University researchers say a [tax fraud detection model was tested at three tax centres](<https://www.businessincameroon.com/public-management/2708-16627-cameroon-built-ai-claims-97-2-precision-in-tax-fraud-detection-but-revenue-impact-remains-unclear>), and the tax directorate has not confirmed it. No single source has been found that says AI is in service in two sectors. Operating would need AI tools in service in the public systems of two or more sectors.

The education minister said in August 2025 that [an AI system marked the 2025 State Exam papers](<https://www.theeastafrican.co.ke/tea/sustainability/innovation/ai-cuts-exam-marking-time-in-congo-5161318>). In the last twelve months, WHO said [its AI-based preparedness platform was in use in the country by October 2026](<https://afro.who.int/countries/democratic-republic-of-congo/news/who-deploys-pdx-preparedness-intelligence-platform-democratic-republic-congo>). On 8 November 2026 the health ministry announced [Etoile Bleue, an emergency medical response system that uses AI to handle alerts](<https://www.wearetech.africa/fr/fils/actualites/tech/rdc-un-systeme-connecte-pour-mieux-organiser-les-interventions-medicales>), which has no launch date. No earlier position has been found for either. Each source names one sector, and no source found says AI is in service in two or more sectors. Operating would need AI tools in service in the public systems of two or more sectors.

WHO says the Comoros [adopted an AI-assisted open-source epidemic intelligence system and trained health surveillance staff on it with the Ministry of Health on 22-25 April 2025](<https://www.afro.who.int/fr/countries/comoros/news/comores-loms-forme-sur-linitiative-dintelligence-epidemique-partir-de-sources-ouvertes-eios>). A 2026 conference poster says [machine-learning models are being developed on routine malaria data to forecast incidence](<https://community.dhis2.org/t/ai-driven-predictive-epidemiology-for-malaria-monitoring-in-the-comoros-using-dhis2-data/72310>). The poster comes from the last twelve months, and no earlier position for it has been found. No source found says an AI tool is in service and producing outputs. Establishing would need an AI tool in service in a public sector's system and producing outputs, such as diagnoses, risk scores, forecasts or notices.

In an account of April 2026, the Cabo Verdean American Medical Society, working with the Ministry of Health, says it has [distributed cloud ECG devices across all islands that make automatic diagnoses with AI](<https://www.asemana.cv/index.php/atualidade/23296-missoes-medicas-do-projeto-continuidade-dos-eua-reforcam-saude-em-cabo-verde-com-tecnologia-de-ponta>). It says AI also lets nurses diagnose cataracts, glaucoma and retinopathy. The account comes from the last twelve months, and no earlier position has been found. It is the only account found of AI at work in a public sector's system, and no measured results have been found. Operating would need AI tools in service in the public systems of two or more sectors.

The ports and free zones authority says an [AI road-monitoring system launched in 2024 uses cameras to detect and locate potholes and cracks along the regional transport corridors](<https://www.dawan.africa/news/djibouti-unveils-ai-tools-to-modernize-ports-and-logistics>). In January 2026 the corridor-road company said its system [made 2,174 detections across four defect types in its first processing](<https://dpcr.dj/2026/01/15/corridorvision-ai-ai-powered-road-condition-monitoring-for-djiboutis-trade-corridors/>). In the last twelve months the Chinese Meteorological Administration [supplied an AI early-warning system, in service from December 2025](<https://www.wearetech.africa/fr/fils/actualites/tech/djibouti-deploie-une-nouvelle-version-de-son-systeme-d-alerte-meteo-fonde-sur-l-ia>). Road transport and weather are separate accounts. No single source found says AI is in service in two or more sectors. Operating would need AI tools in service in the public systems of two or more sectors.

In April 2024 the higher education minister [launched an AI platform that simulates study-field choices for new baccalaureate holders](<https://www.mesrs.dz/en/2024/04/the-launch-of-a-new-digital-platform-to-assist-new-baccalaureate-holders/>). The Ministry of Finance says the customs information system [relies on AI techniques for risk analysis of imports and exports](<https://www.mf.gov.dz/index.php/ar/documentation-ar/grands-dossiers-ar/2174-2025-02-06-14-39-01>). In September 2026, within the last twelve months, the Ministry of Foreign Trade said its [AI-boosted data analysis and cross-checking system detected anomalies in import programme files](<https://www.algerie360.com/importations-suspectes-en-algerie-lia-demasque-des-documents-identiques-chez-plus-de-1000-operateurs/>). No earlier position has been found for it. No single source found says AI is in service in the public systems of two or more sectors. Operating would need AI tools in service in the public systems of two or more sectors.

[In November 2025 the customs head said three smart systems run on the Nafeza platform](<https://www.elwatannews.com/news/details/8169196>). [In September 2026 the tax authority head said AI now calculates real estate disposition tax](<https://www.almasryalyoum.com/news/details/4359416>). [In November 2026 a social solidarity official said the Takaful and Karama cash programme uses AI](<https://almessa.gomhuriaonline.com/764443/>). The last two come from the last twelve months, and no earlier position has been found for either. Each sector's AI is reported in a separate account, and no single source found says AI is in service in two or more sectors. Operating would need AI tools in service in the public systems of two or more sectors.

Delft Imaging, the vendor, says the Ministry of Health [had 2 portable X-ray units and 6 units of its TB-reading AI deployed in 2024](<https://delftimaging.com/impact/eritrea/>). The units serve the TB programme. The vendor says the ministry added 8 more in 2026, within the last twelve months. The ministry's work with the vendor goes back to [a 2020 plan to use the offline AI chest X-ray reader to screen for TB](<https://delft.care/healthcare-radius/>). No other use is described. No source found reports AI in a second sector or measured results. Operating would need AI tools in service in the public systems of two or more sectors.

The Ministry of Revenues and the Customs Commission [unveiled an AI-powered passenger risk management system on 12 October 2025](<https://addisfortune.news/revenue-customs-launch-eight-new-tech-systems>). CGIAR reports that a [fertilizer advisory system run by the Ministry of Agriculture gave AI-based recommendations to 49,000 farmers in 2025](<https://www.cgiar.org/news-events/news/how-ethiopia-built-national-digital-fertilizer-advisory-system>). In the last twelve months, in April 2026, an [AI assistant built with the Ministry of Health was piloted in 15 woredas](<https://www.thereporterethiopia.com/50178/>). Scale-up is planned after evaluation. The Ministry of Education [completed testing of an AI teacher assistant for grades 9-12](<https://birrmetrics.com/ministry-of-education-to-deploy-ai-powered-assistant-for-schools/>) in 2026. In July 2026 [the director general of the Ethiopian AI Institute said AI is widely deployed in justice, public administration and health care](<https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_9274852>).

The revenue authority's deputy commissioner said in May 2025 that it [uses AI and machine learning to find anomalies in tax filings, expose suspicious trade and trigger audits](<https://www.ghanaweb.com/GhanaHomePage/business/GRA-doubles-down-on-AI-ML-to-combat-tax-leakages-1984925>). The Ministry of Finance and the revenue authority said [an AI tool that helps customs officers value and classify imports](<https://www.graphic.com.gh/business/business-news/freight-forwarders-importers-raise-concern-over-publican-ai-o-system-flags-only-values-lower-than-minimum-global-average-ministry-of-finance.html>) was fully rolled out at ports of entry on 11 March 2026. Ghana Health Service and Jacaranda Health [launched an AI maternal health platform in July 2026](<https://gna.org.gh/2026/07/ghs-jacaranda-deploy-ai-tool-for-maternal-care/>). The accounts are separate. Both 2026 dates come from the last twelve months. No earlier position has been found. No single source found says AI is in service in two or more sectors. Operating would need AI tools in service in the public systems of two or more sectors.

[In May 2026 a DIAL case study said the Gambia Revenue Authority uses the Rental Tax Compliance System to choose property owners for audit and visits](<https://dial.global/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/AI-x-DPI-Case-study-The-Gambia.pdf>). [The system gives machine-learning estimates of rental values and compliance risk scores](<https://dial.global/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/AI-x-DPI-Case-study-The-Gambia.pdf>). [On 24 April 2025 the Ministry of Higher Education unveiled the TITA mobile app in Banjul](<https://www.kerrfatou.com/gambias-higher-education-ministry-launches-innovative-tita-mobile-app-to-modernize-tertiary-institutions/>). The DIAL study comes from the last twelve months, and no earlier position has been found. No single source found since October 2023 says AI is in service in the public systems of two or more sectors. Operating would need AI tools in service in the public systems of two or more sectors.

[The health ministry officially launched 'Guinea Salud', an AI chatbot, on 6 June 2025](<https://realequatorialguinea.com/salud/sanidad-lanza-el-asistente-digital-guinea-salud-primer-chatbot-sanitario-con-ia-de-guinea-ecuatorial/>). It is in a pilot phase. In July 2025 the transport and AI ministry [funded a five-month pilot in which university students build and run the country's first AI-integrated weather station](<https://africanian.com/livenews/equatorial-guinea-launches-climate-innovation-project-students-to-build-first-ai-powered-weather-station/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says an AI tool is in service in a public sector's system. Establishing would need an AI tool in service in a public sector's system and producing outputs, such as diagnoses, risk scores, forecasts or notices.

The Health Cabinet Secretary told the Senate in October 2025 that the Social Health Authority's claims platform [uses AI and machine learning to detect abnormal claim patterns, inflated billing and duplicate submissions in real time](<https://www.the-star.co.ke/news/2025-10-30-sha-system-stopped-theft-of-millions-in-fake-claims-duale>). In February 2026 the Secretary said the system had [flagged, rejected and left unpaid Sh12.7 billion of claims](<https://www.the-star.co.ke/news/2026-02-27-duale-ai-blocked-sh127bn-fake-claims-at-sha>). A committee report of December 2025 said it [also rejects some legitimate hospital claims as fraudulent](<https://www.the-star.co.ke/news/2025-12-04-ai-system-flaws-push-sha-into-chaos-mps>). [In November 2026 the Judiciary piloted Mahakama AI, a legal research tool for judges](<https://www.the-star.co.ke/news/2026-11-19-judiciary-pilots-ai-tool-to-tackle-case-backlog>). These reports come from the last twelve months, and no earlier position has been found for the Judiciary pilot. No source found says how widely the means-testing and fertiliser tools are used.

The Executive Mansion says [four AI X-ray machines for TB screening were dedicated and distributed to four hospitals in Montserrado and Margibi](<https://www.emansion.gov.lr/media/press-release/first-lady-dedicates-four-ai-x-ray-machines-tb-diagnosis>) in August 2024. A Partners In Health clinician says [AI chest X-ray reading supported TB screening at James Jenkins Dossen Hospital in Maryland County](<https://www.linkedin.com/posts/otuba-paul-29344955_cphia2025-tb-digitalhealth-activity-7387896239935369216-fBQX>) from March 2023 to January 2025. Within the last twelve months, the Environmental Protection Agency [sought a consultant in April 2026 to build an AI system forecasting floods and droughts](<https://emansion.gov.lr/sites/default/files/documents/5a_REOI_INTERNATIONAL%20CONSULTANTS%20TO%20DEVELOP%20AND%20OPERATIONALIZE%20AN%20AUTOMATED%20DECISION%20MANAGEMENT%20SYSTEM.pdf>). That system was still to be designed. Health is the only sector held with AI in service. Operating would need AI tools in service in the public systems of two or more sectors.

ICESCO says an [initiative launched in Tripoli in July 2024 with the Ministry of Education includes developing a system for integrating AI into the educational process](<https://icesco.org/en/2024/07/17/launch-of-new-initiative-to-integrate-foresight-and-artificial-intelligence-into-educational-process-in-libya-in-partnership-with-icesco/>). It describes work that has begun, and no system at work. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No sector has been found with AI in service. Establishing would need an AI tool in service in a public sector's system and producing outputs, such as diagnoses, risk scores, forecasts or notices.

Qure.ai, the vendor, says its [chest X-ray AI has screened for TB at seven community sites with Partners In Health and the Ministry of Health since July 2022](<https://www.qure.ai/us/impact-stories/transforming-healthcare-in-lesotho-with-ai-a-case-study-on-combating-tuberculosis>). By March 2024 it had [read over 6,000 scans and identified about 1,100 people with potential TB](<https://www.qure.ai/us/impact-stories/transforming-healthcare-in-lesotho-with-ai-a-case-study-on-combating-tuberculosis>). [In October 2026 Minister Nthati Moorosi said her ministry was developing an AI chatbot with the agriculture ministry to advise farmers through extension services](<https://lestimes.com/?p=91936>). That comes from the last twelve months, and no earlier position has been found. No single source found says AI is in service in two or more sectors. Operating would need AI tools in service in the public systems of two or more sectors.

[Customs says its BADR system, which it calls applied AI, handled 1,540 fraud alerts in 2024](<https://fr.hespress.com/438610-adii-2024-plus-de-recettes-plus-de-fluidite-plus-de-technologie.html>). [In 2025 the Interior Ministry trained a model to detect false declarations in the social register](<https://telquel.ma/instant-t/2025/11/06/le-ministere-de-linterieur-developpe-un-systeme-intelligent-pour-detecter-les-fraudes-dans-le-registre-social-unifie_1959757/>). [The medicines agency launched a licensing platform with AI analysis tools on 31 March 2026](<https://maroc.ma/fr/actualites/lancement-de-la-plateforme-tarkhiss-pour-accelerer-la-transformation-digitale-du-secteur-de-la-sante>). [In November 2026 customs and the Korea Customs Service entered the last phase of a project applying AI to revenue management](<https://www.moroccoworldnews.com/2026/11/345265/morocco-korea-advance-customs-cooperation-on-ai-digitalization/>), begun in May. The last two come from the last twelve months, and no earlier position has been found for either. No source found since October 2023 reports measured results of AI outside customs.

The customs director general told an IMF panel on 27 March 2025 that the [AI-based risk assessment tool analyses millions of clearance records](<https://www.douanes.gov.mg/la-douane-malagasy-un-modele-regional-dans-lusage-de-la-donnee-et-de-lia/>). On 7 October 2025 customs [launched a generative-AI agent that analyses invoices and detects false or inconsistent ones](<https://www.douanes.gov.mg/lagent-svo-deploye-la-douane-franchit-une-nouvelle-etape/>). In June 2026, within the last twelve months, the judicial authorities [are evaluating AI tools for judicial support](<https://www.wearetech.africa/en/fils-uk/news/public-management/madagascar-develops-digital-criminal-records-platform-to-modernize-justice-system>), which are not yet in service. No single source found says AI is in service in the public systems of two or more sectors. Operating would need AI tools in service in the public systems of two or more sectors.

DHIS2 says a [climate and health modelling platform was installed in Mozambique's production DHIS2](<https://dhis2.org/pt-pt/climate/country-profiles/mozambique/>), and that it is not yet operational. In early 2024 the country had [two climate-based malaria forecasting efforts, neither yet in routine use](<https://dhis2.org/pt-pt/chap-lessons-learned/>). [In December 2025 WHO said the malaria programme was piloting AI analysis of drone images in Matola](<https://www.afro.who.int/pt/countries/mozambique/news/drones-para-proteger-nossas-comunidades-da-malaria>). That pilot comes from the last twelve months, after the position of early 2024. No source found says an AI tool is in service. Establishing would need an AI tool in service in a public sector's system and producing outputs, such as diagnoses, risk scores, forecasts or notices.

A January 2026 report says the meteorological office and UNDP [run an AI-based agrometeorological early warning system whose services already reach 20 women's cooperatives in Rosso](<https://ami.mr/fr/archives/287234>). They [trained regional staff on it in September 2026](<https://ami.mr/fr/archives/301958>). In November 2024 the digital ministry [presented a pilot of AI virtual teachers and assistants](<https://mtnima.gov.mr/fr/un-stand-du-mtnima-sur-lia-en-marge-de-la-conference-des-femmes-creatives-du-monde-arabe-et-dafrique/>). The 2026 reports come from the last twelve months, and no earlier position has been found for them. Weather and climate early warning is the only sector held with AI in service. Operating would need AI tools in service in the public systems of two or more sectors.

In August 2026 the ICT minister said [the Central Water Authority's AI-enabled water leakage reporting service is available through the government's KOREK super app](<https://mitci.govmu.org/mitci/online-motor-vehicle-licence-system-launched-for-taxi-operators/>). Mauritius Telecom says [its MyTLearn AI tutor, developed with the Ministry of Education, has completed pilots in ten schools](<https://platformafrica.com/2026/07/16/from-connectivity-to-intelligence-how-mauritius-telecom-is-building-the-intelligent-layer-of-everyday-mauritius/>). [In November 2026 it said its myt Learn AI tutor was rolling out in schools for selected grades](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/11/18/cassava-and-mauritius-telecom-partner-to-expand-ai-services-across-africa/>). These dates come from the last twelve months, and no earlier position has been found. The water leak reporting is the one in service, and the education tools are pilots. No source found since October 2023 says AI is in service in the public systems of two or more sectors. Operating would need AI tools in service in the public systems of two or more sectors.

A preprint reports that an [AI tool transcribing photographed HIV testing registers reached 853 of 867 HIV testing facilities (98%) by September 2024](<https://www.medrxiv.org/content/10.64898/2026.01.08.26343708v1>). Lead farmers have [used an AI crop app since 2023 to get pest advisories](<https://mwnation.com/ai-bridges-extension-gap/>). The revenue authority's [digital excise stamp platform uses AI to detect anomalies and flag risks](<https://mwnation.com/digital-tax-stamps-enhance-revenue-compliance-mra/>), as reported in July 2026. The July 2026 report comes from the last twelve months, and no earlier position has been found. Health, agriculture and tax each have AI in service, in separate accounts. No single source found says AI is in service in the public systems of two or more sectors. Operating would need AI tools in service in the public systems of two or more sectors.

The Health Minister said in March 2025 that Namibia has [introduced AI-powered digital chest X-ray technology for TB screening and early diagnosis](<https://english.news.cn/africa/20250329/a143c7051c3f442db05e338cfee1f561/c.html>). In September 2026 [two AI tutoring labs opened at a government secondary school in Luderitz](<https://aitsafrika.com/education/namibias-first-ai-tutoring-labs-launched-in-lderitz-nmh018656-3014-22949-22972>). The agriculture ministry [signed a N$39.5 million contract for AI and satellite crop monitoring](<https://observer24.com.na/questions-mount-over-n39-5m-us-agriculture-ai-deal/>).
